tasks.description: In docs/hugo/content/guide/expressions.md, add a section documenting the new ASO-specific CEL function `aso.parseResourceId(string)`. Explain that it parses an ARM resource ID string and returns a `ResourceID` object exposing fields `subscriptionId`, `resourceGroupName`, `provider`, `location`, `name`, a nested `resourceType` object (with `namespace` and `type`), and a recursive `parent` field for hierarchical IDs. Include an example such as `aso.parseResourceId(self.status.id).subscriptionId` and note it is surfaced under the `aso` namespace to avoid collisions with user identifiers.

In docs/hugo/content/guide/frequently-asked-questions.md, extend the workload identity section (injecting ASO-created User Managed Identity details) to mention that `aso.parseResourceId` can be used in `operatorSpec.secretExpressions` to derive the subscription ID (e.g. `aso.parseResourceId(self.status.id).subscriptionId`) alongside `self.status.tenantId` and `self.status.clientId`, enabling a complete workload identity credential secret.
